requirement.description: HTTP/2 hooks are not properly capturing request/response data from HTTP/2 connections. Tests show that records are created but lack essential data like URL, method, status code, headers, and content.
requirement.contract: Ensure HTTP/2 hooks properly capture and populate HTTP/2 request and response data including URL, method, status code, headers, and content. Records must be created with proper HTTP/2 metadata and populated with actual HTTP/2 frame data when it becomes available.

requirement.description: HTTP/2 record parsing logic is incomplete and doesn't correctly extract HTTP/2 headers and data from raw frame data. The HTTP/2 record classes don't properly parse pseudo-headers (:method, :path, :authority, :status) or handle the raw data extraction.
requirement.contract: Implement complete HTTP/2 frame parsing logic to extract headers, method, path, authority, status code, and content from raw HTTP/2 frame data. Ensure HTTP2RecordRequest and HTTP2RecordResponse properly parse HTTP/2 pseudo-headers and extract request/response data.

requirement.description: HTTP/2 hook is not properly integrated with the overall hook system. The order of hook application may be causing conflicts or preventing proper interception of HTTP/2 traffic.
requirement.contract: Ensure HTTP/2 hook is properly integrated with all other hooks and that the hook ordering allows proper interception of HTTP/2 traffic. The hook should be applied consistently with other HTTP hooks.

requirement.description: HTTP records management does not properly handle HTTP/2 records. The add_new_record method doesn't properly distinguish between HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 records, and there's no mechanism to handle HTTP/2-specific record types.
requirement.contract: Update HTTP records management to properly handle HTTP/2 record creation. Ensure add_new_record method properly creates HTTP2Record instances when record_type="http2" and that records are correctly stored and accessible.

requirement.description: HTTPX hooks are duplicated from h2.py and don't properly support HTTP/2 interception. The HTTPX hook implementation should be updated to properly integrate with HTTP/2 hooks and handle HTTP/2 traffic.
requirement.contract: Ensure HTTPX hook properly handles HTTP/2 requests and integrates with HTTP/2 hooks. Update the HTTPX hook to properly support HTTP/2 interception and record creation.
